<reason>PRO won the central clash on fixed supply, trust concentration, and conflict of interest. CON's migration/redundancy dilemma was sharp but PRO answered it: app-locks make a fair lane enforceable where volume and trust live, and price-linked fees track extraction not verification cost. CON never neutralized platform double-dipping or explained how surge pricing protects the nurse, leaving PRO's fair-lane route live.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B's fixed-supply reply plus price-linked fee tell: caps don't need to bake seats, and same scan costing same at $60 vs $600 exposes the skim as gouge-cut, collapsing CON's protection/funding defense.</best_rebuttal>
